requirement: BUILD_AGENT_RUNBOOK Stage 1: the Owner must be given an explicit extension install entry point, not merely told the source exists.

package_identity.note: Built inside the image from apps/browser-extension, so a clean deploy cannot inherit a stale host ZIP.

owner_steps_to_unblock_sa205: Open https://social-archive.linzezhang.com/extension-install through the existing Cloudflare Access session and download the package.

Unzip it, then load it in the Chrome profile that is already signed in to Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou and Bilibili: chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, Load unpacked, select the unzipped folder.
Say when the extension is loaded. A one-time pairing code will be minted then, because it expires in 10 minutes; the supply path is already verified working against the live service.
The real four-platform Owner Canary can then run. No password, Cookie or token will ever be requested or handled.
why_the_agent_cannot_do_this: No Chrome is connected to the agent session, so the Owner's logged-in profile is unreachable. Prior runs additionally established that neither the Extensions manager controls nor the DevTools Extensions.loadUnpacked command are available through the controlled browser surface.
does_not_establish: SA-205 PASS. No extension is installed, no pairing exchange has occurred against production, and no platform account has been connected or mirrored.

stale_supplementary_acceptance_script_fo.problem: It still drives the v0.0.0.5 popup: it asserts a '保存到我的档案馆 默认归档 L0＋L1＋L3' button and a '读取当前列表' button as the primary actions, and reads #connectionSummary and #scanList. The shipped v0.0.0.6 popup no longer has #connectionSummary or #scanList, and its primary action is the account-mirror block #primarySync / #primarySyncLabel / #primarySyncHint with #manageAccounts and #accountList. Single-page save correctly survives only as the documented fallback.
stale_supplementary_acceptance_script_fo.why_it_matters: Per-item capture as the Golden Path is explicitly superseded in CANONICAL_STATE, so an acceptance script asserting it would both fail on removed ids and, worse, verify the wrong Golden Path.
stale_supplementary_acceptance_script_fo.why_it_was_not_edited: No task in TASK_GRAPH.json, the acceptance matrix or BUILD_AGENT_RUNBOOK runs this script; it appears only in MANIFEST.sha256, the pack verifier's file check and a remediation log. It also needs Playwright and /usr/bin/chromium, neither of which exists on this machine, so any edit would be unvalidated. Changing a script that no gate exercises and that cannot be run here would be unjustified risk.
stale_supplementary_acceptance_script_fo.what_to_do_in_the_canary_environment: If this script is ever run, update it first against the shipped popup: assert #primarySync visible with #primarySyncLabel '同步全部已连接账号' and #primarySyncHint '新增内容会自动进入资料库', #manageAccounts containing '连接与管理账号', and #accountList, keeping the single-save path as fallback only.
stale_supplementary_acceptance_script_fo.note_on_the_frozen_copy: The frozen pack's own copy of this script expects '立即同步全部账号' and '无需逐条打开帖子', which contradicts the frozen tests/focused/test_ui_contract.py that asserts '同步全部已连接账号' and passes against the shipped extension. The shipped wording is the one corroborated by a passing frozen contract test.
